title: MSA/DPA pilot amendment fast-path and rollback telemetry for short-term pilots
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Sales teams frequently spin up short-term pilot agreements (30–90 days) that need tailored MSA/DPA amendments (limited indemnity, temporary liability caps, trial data processing notes). Current legal turnaround (3–7 business days) slows pilot activation and reduces conversion from trials to paid Dedicated/Private contracts.

Goal: Implement an operational 'fast-path' for low-risk pilots with pre-defined amendment templates and an automated rollback/alert telemetry system that allows legal to pre-approve bounded concessions for pilot customers and revoke them automatically if risk signals trigger during the pilot.

Scope: Build the contract amendment templates, decision matrix for automated approval, UI in Console for sales to request/attach a pilot amendment, backend flagging and telemetry for runtime risk signals (usage spikes, exfil patterns, abnormal token distribution), and an operational rollback playbook for legal + support. Integrate with pricing experiment triggers so pilots tied to experiments can be fast-tracked without manual redlines.

Success metrics: average pilot time-to-sign reduced from 4.8 days -> <= 24 hours; % of pilots converted to paid within 90 days increases by 12%; number of manual legal redlines for pilots reduced by 70%.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-approved amendment templates (MSA rider + scoped DPA addendum) stored in Confluence and accessible from Console
Console UI: 'Request Pilot Amendment' flow that captures pilot duration, expected usage, customer tier, and experiment id
Auto-score engine assigns a green/yellow/red risk band; green auto-approves within policy, yellow queues for 24h expedited review, red blocks and routes to legal
Telemetry: runtime alerts generated when pilot crosses pre-set thresholds (usage 3x baseline, egress > X GB/day, anomalous prompt patterns)
Rollback action: system toggles pilot flags and revokes fast-path concessions; legal receives an automated docket with summary + audit trail
End-to-end playbook documented with contact points, SLAs, and rollback runbook
Integration tests for the approval flow and telemetry-triggered rollback exist in CI and a canary env

rollback_criteria: Pilot usage > 3x committed token baseline for 48h
Unusual egress patterns (sustained > 2x historical egress for account)
Model misuse signals (prompt pattern classifier score > 0.8)
Security incident or external report affecting data processing
